column1: # Pre-push host table schema. The public table designates no deployment host.
# The caller declares PREPUSH_PRIVATE_TABLE_REL. The full private table is read
# through ONEX_WORKSPACE_CONFIG_ROOT, else the private workspace repository
# beside OMNI_HOME. In a git root it must be committed and match HEAD.
# With no private table only the neutral disabled row below remains.
# Verified private rows travel beside the bundle so the remote guard reads them.
# The former @private tokens and placement-only overlay are no longer used:
# all fifteen columns, including identity and capacity, belong in the private table.
# Columns (TAB separated; no tabs inside fields):
# label: stable row id, also names PREPUSH_HOST_OVERRIDE_<LABEL uppercased>.
# role: capacity (placement and identity) or identity (identity only).
# hostname: lowercased hostname -s; ssh_target: bare transport host, or -.
# cores: nominal count; uv_abs_path: absolute uv path; uv_min_version: floor.
# workroot: absolute writable deployment path outside per-user home trees.
# slot_mode: lockdir, queue or none; slots: concurrent heavy-suite capacity.
# repos_denied: comma-separated repo names or -; mode: authorizing/shadow/disabled.
# heavy_local: allowed or prefer_remote; placement_tier: default or last_resort.
# note: reasoned deployment policy. Add or enable rows in the private table.
#label
local
column15: Neutral default row; configure the private deployment table to enable hosts.
